defects.description: audit() trusts accepted_events.command_digest instead of reconstructing it from persisted command_type/payload/expected-version/effect material. Tampering payload_json while leaving command_digest unchanged is not detected.
defects.contract_impact: Violates the intended S5-I13/S5-16 evidence-lineage/tamper-detection boundary and makes the current S5-16 test materially incomplete.

defects.description: audit() checks current project_state.version but does not recompute and verify project_state.state_digest against state_json. Current authoritative state content can be modified without audit detection if the version is left unchanged.
defects.contract_impact: Undermines reconstruction of why the current authoritative state exists and contradicts the broad tamper-detection claim made by R2.

next_required_action: Repair audit reconstruction and extend frozen-case S5-16 adversarial coverage without weakening the frozen contract; rerun exact construction CI; issue a fresh candidate-bound R2. R3 is required only after a non-defective fresh R2 candidate exists.
